title: Pan-Seared Carrot Skillet with Wcharred Flavor
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring pan-seared carrots and a hint of wcharred goodness.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the wcharred to the skillet and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with bouncy and serve hot.
If using qq, sprinkle over the carrots before serving.
